title: Hearty Crispy Ukrainian Potato Dumplings
description: A traditional Ukrainian dish featuring crispy potato dumplings with a hint of yellow food coloring and bonito shave, perfect for kids and halal-friendly, these dumplings are a treat for the whole family to enjoy together on a chilly evening.
instructions: In a large bowl combine grated potatoes, flour, yellow food coloring, bonito shave, eggs, melted butter, salt, and black pepper, mix well until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for about 10 minutes until it becomes smooth and pliable.
Divide the dough into small pieces and shape each piece into a ball.
Flatten each ball into a disk shape.
Heat about 1/2 inch of oil in a large frying pan over medium heat.
When the oil is hot, add a few of the potato dumplings to the pan and fry until they are golden brown and crispy.
Repeat the frying process with the remaining dumplings.
Remove the dumplings from the oil and place them on a paper towel lined plate to drain excess oil.
Serve the dumplings hot and enjoy.
